mapper.sql: ua.account_id, ua.employee_id, ua.username, ua.password_hash, ua.role_code, ua.status, ua.last_login_at, e.full_name, COALESCE(r.clinic_id, dc.clinic_id) AS clinic_id, c.clinic_name

JOIN employee e ON e.employee_id = ua.employee_id LEFT JOIN receptionist r ON r.employee_id = ua.employee_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT d.clinic_id FROM dentist_clinic d WHERE d.employee_id = ua.employee_id ORDER BY d.is_primary DESC, d.clinic_id LIMIT 1 ) dc ON TRUE LEFT JOIN clinic c ON c.clinic_id = COALESCE(r.clinic_id, dc.clinic_id)
